human_understanding_delta: The exact mixed equality chart extends to a complete one-parameter theorem. After scaling by either tangent radius, all cube roots cancel and both critical chords factor as a double-contact square times a convex quadratic negative at its endpoints. Three ray tails follow by power domination and the fourth by a decreasing sparse quartic. Opposite signs of Re z on the two connectors then transfer the left certificate to every u below the sharp transition and the right certificate to every u above it, closing H_u(z)=Re(uz+iz^2-z^5) for all u>=0.
unresolved_downstream_bottleneck: Extend the two-connector atlas from the canonical phase slice to a quantitative phase neighbourhood, then cover the remaining compact mixed coefficient space and transfer through the finite near-Fekete expansion.
next_stage_owner: Refinery: use the strict off-contact margins and the paired cubic sign at the double contacts to prove a phase-neighbourhood stability theorem around the canonical slice.
claim_ceiling: This proves the complete canonical family Re(uz+iz^2-z^5), u>=0. It does not prove the global two-phase mixed-model selector, the full near-Fekete perturbation theorem, or unrestricted Erdős #1041.
